origin: Team WRT, or We Racing Together, emerged from the passionate dreams of Vincent Vosse and Yves Weerts in 2009. Both seasoned racers in their own right, Vosse and Weerts envisioned a Belgian racing outfit that could punch above its weight in the GT racing world. Starting with a modest budget and a small crew, they initially focused on the Blancpain Endurance Series, fielding a single Audi R8 LMS. Early races were a struggle, battling reliability issues and driver inexperience, but the team's unwavering determination soon started to pay off. A breakthrough podium finish at the Spa 24 Hours in 2011 marked a turning point, establishing WRT as a serious contender.
philosophy: WRT's racing philosophy centers on meticulous preparation, aggressive strategy, and fostering a close-knit team environment. They believe in empowering their drivers and engineers, encouraging open communication and shared problem-solving. Their approach to car development is data-driven, constantly seeking marginal gains through detailed analysis and rigorous testing. Team culture emphasizes hard work, respect, and a relentless pursuit of excellence, both on and off the track.
achievements: Victory at the Spa 24 Hours (multiple times)
FIA GT World Cup victory at Macau
Multiple victories in various GT World Challenge Europe events
Success in DTM with customer teams

teamPrincipal.name: Vincent Vosse
teamPrincipal.background: Vincent Vosse, a former racing driver himself, brings a racer's understanding and passion to his role as team principal. He is known for his calm demeanor under pressure and his ability to motivate his team to perform at their best.

keyFigures.name: Yves Weerts
keyFigures.description: Yves Weerts provides the crucial financial backing and strategic vision for the team. His business acumen and motorsport passion have been instrumental in WRT's growth and success.

keyFigures.name: Pierre Dieudonné
keyFigures.description: Pierre Dieudonné is the mastermind behind WRT's technical prowess. His meticulous attention to detail and innovative engineering solutions are key to maximizing car performance.

headquarters: Team WRT operates from a well-equipped facility in Baudour, Belgium. While not the most extravagant, their headquarters houses a dedicated workshop, engineering office, and driver training simulator.
fanBase: WRT enjoys a strong following, particularly among Belgian motorsport enthusiasts. Their fans are known for their passionate support and unwavering loyalty, often seen sporting the team's distinctive colors at races across Europe.
